name: UUPS Initializer Takeover
threat_model: An attacker overwrites the owner of a legitimately initialized vulnerable proxy, upgrades its implementation, and executes arbitrary proxy-context logic to drain funds.
assumptions: The proxy uses EIP-1967 implementation storage and delegatecall initialization.
The vulnerable initializer permits unconditional ownership reassignment even after legitimate initialization.
The remediated path initializes atomically with deployment and locks the implementation instance.
invariant: Privileged proxy state is established once by the intended deployer as part of deployment, and only an authorized implementation advertising the expected UUID can replace it. The UUID check verifies identity, not storage-layout or behavioral compatibility; layout compatibility needs separate validation.

detector_expectations.expectation: expected on the deliberately vulnerable upgrade path
expected on the deliberately vulnerable implementation
one-shot initialization and implementation compatibility require semantic tests
